habitual_be.rule: Unconjugated 'be' marks habitual or recurrent actions
habitual_be.example: He be working on models = He habitually works on models.

copula_deletion.rule: Zero copula in contexts where Standard English allows contraction

negative_concord.rule: Multiple negative markers reinforcing a single negative proposition

Chicano_English.phonology: Less vowel reduction in unstressed syllables, /tʃ/ and /ʃ/ alternation
Chicano_English.prosody: Higher fundamental frequency pitch peaks on phrase finals

Creole_contact_features.tense_aspect_markers: Pre-verbal particles marking aspect (e.g., 'don' for completive aspect)
Creole_contact_features.serial_verb_constructions: Multiple verbs within a single clause without overt coordination
